value: Four-class confusion matrix excludes calibration, face-missing, and unclassified outputs; counts for each are reported separately.
raw_model_behavior is direct classifier output; predicted_label is the final rule/temporal-filter decision.
Calibration status is copied from the prediction record's raw_behavior field and those frames are excluded.
Decoded frames outside all ground-truth intervals are retained in predictions.csv and excluded from classification metrics.
Face-missing outputs are excluded from class metrics and reported separately; they are never coerced to NORMAL.
Frames inside behavior-labeled intervals are treated as frames where a driver face is expected; the annotations do not provide independent face-visibility labels.
